title: Etale derived origin with transport of supplied constant models on a finite-coefficient slice
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, B a finite commutative ring in the scheme universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet, and phi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism. Let K be any derived R-module object and V an etale chart. Suppose the restrictions of H^q(K) to V vanish outside [a,b], a<=b, and each H^q(K) has etale-local finite constant B-module models after scalar extension by phi on every chart over V. Then K restricted to V descends to an object L on V.left_et with coefficients ULift(B). It has the same vanishing interval and etale-local finite module cohomology. For every W->V and every supplied algebraic B-complex P, a derived constant model of the restriction of L on W.left transports to the specified actual ringed proetale slice model of K using phi and finiteModelConstantComplex. No constant complex model is asserted to exist. Constant realizations and scalar change use [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data], and restriction uses [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. The constant realization functor is assumed to preserve zero morphisms.

source.place: Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived; finite comparison and weakly etale localization

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed exact fixed-scalar restriction F_V. The vanishing hypothesis on the actual ringed slice implies vanishing of F_V(H^q K), and the exact homology comparison identifies this with H^q(F_V K). Thus the restricted fixed-coefficient derived object has the same interval [a,b].

Apply the abelian heart origin lemma separately to H^q(K). Compose its origin marking with the exact homology comparison to obtain etale origins G_q of every H^q(F_V K), with their local finite models.

Apply the already proved bounded-heart origin theorem. It produces an etale complex L and a marking nu^*L ~= F_V K. Use the exact homology comparison of nu^* and faithfulness to reflect the interval [a,b]. Full faithfulness on the abelian hearts lifts the isomorphism nu^*H^qL ~= nu^*G_q to H^qL ~= G_q. Restrict this isomorphism to each member of the covers of G_q and compose with its finite constant models.

Apply the marked constant-model transport lemma to L and its origin marking for each W->V and supplied P. This proves the actual ringed-slice transport conclusion; it does not assert existence of a constant complex model.

theorem finiteCoefficient_etale_slice_origin
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R))) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hvan : let R₀ := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R);
      ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)))
    (hloc : let R₀ := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R);
      ∀ (q : ℤ) (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X φ).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                  koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))) :
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory
        (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))),
      (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ (q : ℤ) (W : V.left.Etale),
        ∃ (I : Type (t + 1)) (U : I → V.left.Etale) (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ W),
          Sieve.ofArrows U f ∈ V.left.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ i, ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B),
            Module.Finite (ULift.{t + 1} B) N ∧ Nonempty
              (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L).over (U i) ≅
                (constantSheaf (V.left.smallEtaleTopology.over (U i))
                  (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).obj N)) ∧
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V)
        (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ),
        Nonempty
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar
              (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B)) g.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj L ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((constantSheaf W.left.smallEtaleTopology
                (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom
                  ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) →
        Nonempty
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
            ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
              ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
                  (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
              ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P))))
